lower3rd._comment_reminderMinutes: Optional personal reminder for the operator who shows this template. Minutes from 1 to 1440; 0 or absent disables it. Long-running templates never send this reminder.
lower3rd._comment_fields: A field is either a plain variable name, or an object with label, maxLength, required, and sensitive. sensitive=true prevents recent-value storage. Limit resolution: field maxLength -> template maxLength -> Settings.MaxFieldLength.

sponsor-bug._comment_longRunning: A graphic meant to stay on air all day. Exempts it from the 'on air suspiciously long' alert and from personal elapsed-time reminders, which otherwise report a permanent logo or ticker. Cinegy's own declared Duration is honoured too, so this is only needed when the engine does not give one.
sponsor-bug.description: Sponsor bug, no editable text fields
